punchline: Herman lists what others can give a trauma survivor: advice, support, assistance, affection and care, but not cure.
thirty_sec: In Trauma and Recovery, Judith Herman puts empowerment first: the survivor must be the author and arbiter of her own recovery. Others can give advice, support, assistance, affection and care, but not cure. Yet recovery cannot happen in isolation, so safety comes first and then relationships that rebuild trust.
